finding.summary: label_changes compares case files against meta['commit'] (the agent commit) rather than the cases commit at run time. If the eval run was performed at a different commit than the agent version, this will incorrectly attribute case changes to the run period.
finding.fix: Store the cases commit in run.json at eval time (like the agent commit), and use that as the 'since' reference for label_changes. Alternatively, document that runs must be executed at the agent commit.

label: real_issue
label_reason: Commit 02d37e7 in the PR cites finding R45-fee8a9a-013.
